title: Instant Quit
description: Disconnect from any server or world instantly with a single keypress (Insert). Client-side only
body:
Emergency Leave
Have you ever been in a situation where you needed to leave a server instantly? No more fumbling through the Escape menu while your character is in danger. With Emergency Leave, you are just one button away from safety.

✨ Features
Instant Disconnect: Returns you to the Title Screen or Server List immediately.

"Is this cheating? No, it just automates the 'Save & Quit' process. However, check your server's rules regarding 'Combat Logging' before using it in PvP!"

Client-Side Only: This mod does not need to be installed on the server. You can use it anywhere!

Simple Keybind: Default key is Insert (can be customized in the code).

Lightweight: Minimal impact on game performance.

🛠 How to use
Simply press the Insert key while in-game. The mod will safely close your current session:

In Multiplayer: Drops connection and returns you to the Server List.

In Singleplayer: Saves the world and returns you to the Main Menu.

⚠️ Compatibility
Environment: Client-side only. Do not install on servers.
